hero.title: The One-Number Baby Budget
hero.subtitle: A first-year household money system that replaces cart panic and silent shortfalls with one trusted budget number, a Buy/Wait/Never list, and a 30-day use audit.
hero.one_line_promise: A written first-year budget both partners follow — so every baby purchase has a place, and nothing essential is missed for lack of a number.

short_description: A written first-year budget both partners follow — so every baby purchase has a place, and nothing essential is missed for lack of a number.
trust_line: Educational content — not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. Money guidance is general education, not regulated personal financial advice; it never guarantees savings, affordability, debt outcomes, income growth, or investment returns.
evidence_label: Educational content informed by sourced research and clinical guidance. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.

situation_block.label: Your situation
situation_block.body: New recurring costs collide with shrunken income every month without a single trusted number, so every purchase is feared and every bill restarts the fight. No first-year budget exists, therefore money disappears and the couple fights over baby spending.
